DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Jaundice (likely Breastfeeding Jaundice).

I have noted the baby is two weeks old, exclusively breastfed, and has gained weight appropriately. Since the jaundice appeared after the first week and the infant is feeding well, this points toward a physiological cause related to milk supply rather than infection or severe pathology. No further tests are needed at this time; please continue frequent breastfeeding.
